<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600" width="800" height="600">
  <defs>
    <!-- Sky gradient -->
    <linearGradient id="sky" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#8ed6ff"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#e9f9ff"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <!-- Bottle glass gradient -->
    <linearGradient id="glass" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#7ee8b2" stop-opacity="0.9"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#3fbf7f" stop-opacity="0.95"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#1e7d50" stop-opacity="0.9"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <!-- Anteater fur gradient -->
    <linearGradient id="fur" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#b98a5e"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#8a603c"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <!-- Wheel rim gradient -->
    <radialGradient id="rim" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#e0e0e0"/>
      <stop offset="85%" stop-color="#9aa0a6"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#5f6368"/>
    </radialGradient>

    <!-- A single bottle, reusable via <use> -->
    <g id="bottle">
      <rect x="-9" y="-14" width="18" height="9" rx="2" fill="#c8f7dd" stroke="#1e7d50" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <rect x="-6" y="-22" width="12" height="9" rx="2" fill="#a8eecb" stroke="#1e7d50" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <path d="M-9,-5 Q-12,-2 -12,3 L-12,28 Q-12,33 -7,33 L7,33 Q12,33 12,28 L12,3 Q12,-2 9,-5 Z"
            fill="url(#glass)" stroke="#15613c" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <rect x="-8" y="8" width="16" height="11" rx="1.5" fill="#fff8e1" stroke="#15613c" stroke-width="1.2"/>
      <path d="M-3,10 L-3,17 M0,10 L0,17 M3,10 L3,17" stroke="#7aa88f" stroke-width="1"/>
      <path d="M-8,-2 Q-10,0 -10,6 L-10,26" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-opacity="0.6" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Juggling motion paths for three bottles -->
    <path id="juggle1" d="M0,0 C-70,-130 -60,-190 0,-205 C60,-190 70,-130 0,0 Z"/>
    <path id="juggle2" d="M0,0 C60,-130 70,-190 0,-205 C-60,-190 -70,-130 0,0 Z"/>
    <path id="juggle3" d="M0,0 C-35,-160 35,-160 0,-205 C35,-160 -35,-160 0,0 Z"/>
  </defs>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="800" height="600" fill="url(#sky)"/>
  <circle cx="680" cy="100" r="55" fill="#fff3b0" opacity="0.9">
    <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.75;1;0.75" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </circle>
  <!-- Clouds drifting -->
  <g fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.85">
    <g>
      <ellipse cx="150" cy="110" rx="55" ry="22"/>
      <ellipse cx="185" cy="95" rx="40" ry="25"/>
      <ellipse cx="115" cy="98" rx="35" ry="20"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" from="-60 0" to="820 0" dur="45s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </g>
    <g opacity="0.7">
      <ellipse cx="400" cy="70" rx="45" ry="18"/>
      <ellipse cx="430" cy="58" rx="32" ry="20"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" from="-500 0" to="900 0" dur="60s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </g>
  </g>
  <!-- Ground -->
  <rect y="540" width="800" height="60" fill="#7bc47f"/>
  <rect y="540" width="800" height="8" fill="#5fa765"/>

  <!-- Whole rider bobs gently -->
  <g>
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0 0; 0 -6; 0 0; 0 3; 0 0" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>

    <!-- ===== Unicycle ===== -->
    <g>
      <!-- Wheel rotates -->
      <g transform="translate(400,440)">
        <g>
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0" to="360" dur="1.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
          <circle r="78" fill="none" stroke="url(#rim)" stroke-width="12"/>
          <circle r="78" fill="none" stroke="#303134" stroke-width="3"/>
          <circle r="66" fill="none" stroke="#dfe3e6" stroke-width="2"/>
          <!-- spokes -->
          <g stroke="#b9bec2" stroke-width="2">
            <line x1="-66" y1="0" x2="66" y2="0"/>
            <line x1="0" y1="-66" x2="0" y2="66"/>
            <line x1="-47" y1="-47" x2="47" y2="47"/>
            <line x1="-47" y1="47" x2="47" y2="-47"/>
            <line x1="-25" y1="-61" x2="25" y2="61"/>
            <line x1="-61" y1="-25" x2="61" y2="25"/>
            <line x1="-61" y1="25" x2="61" y2="-25"/>
            <line x1="-25" y1="61" x2="25" y2="-61"/>
          </g>
          <circle r="10" fill="#c0c5c9" stroke="#5f6368" stroke-width="2"/>
        </g>
      </g>
      <!-- Fork + seat post -->
      <rect x="394" y="352" width="12" height="90" rx="5" fill="#cf4b3e" stroke="#8e2d24" stroke-width="2"/>
      <rect x="378" y="338" width="44" height="14" rx="7" fill="#3a3a3a"/>
      <!-- pedals rotate -->
      <g transform="translate(400,440)">
        <g>
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0" to="360" dur="1.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
          <rect x="-46" y="-3" width="26" height="7" rx="3" fill="#55595e"/>
          <rect x="20" y="-3" width="26" height="7" rx="3" fill="#55595e"/>
          <line x1="-33" y1="0" x2="33" y2="0" stroke="#8a8f94" stroke-width="4"/>
        </g>
      </g>
    </g>

    <!-- ===== Anteater ===== -->
    <g transform="translate(400,335)">
      <!-- Legs pedaling -->
      <g stroke="#8a603c" stroke-width="13" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none">
        <g>
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="-18 0 20; 22 0 20; -18 0 20" dur="1.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
          <path d="M-12,10 Q-32,55 -40,100"/>
          <path d="M-40,100 l-8,8" stroke-width="10"/>
        </g>
        <g>
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="22 0 20; -18 0 20; 22 0 20" dur="1.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
          <path d="M12,10 Q32,55 40,100"/>
          <path d="M40,100 l8,8" stroke-width="10"/>
        </g>
      </g>

      <!-- Body -->
      <ellipse cx="0" cy="-30" rx="52" ry="62" fill="url(#fur)" stroke="#6f4a2b" stroke-width="2.5"/>
      <!-- Belly patch -->
      <ellipse cx="5" cy="-18" rx="34" ry="44" fill="#d8b58c" opacity="0.85"/>
      <!-- Shaggy fur tufts -->
      <g fill="#a97a4f" stroke="#6f4a2b" stroke-width="1.5">
        <path d="M-45,-55 l-16,-10 12,20 -18,-2 18,16 z"/>
        <path d="M40,-58 l16,-12 -10,22 18,0 -20,14 z"/>
        <path d="M-48,-12 l-18,4 16,12 -16,8 20,2 z"/>
        <path d="M44,-10 l18,6 -16,10 16,10 -20,0 z"/>
      </g>

      <!-- Head / long snout -->
      <g transform="translate(0,-85)">
        <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="34" ry="30" fill="url(#fur)" stroke="#6f4a2b" stroke-width="2.5"/>
        <!-- eye + patch -->
        <ellipse cx="10" cy="-8" rx="13" ry="10" fill="#4a3320" opacity="0.55" transform="rotate(-12 10 -8)"/>
        <circle cx="12" cy="-8" r="5" fill="#1b1410"/>
        <circle cx="13.5" cy="-9.5" r="1.6" fill="#ffffff"/>
        <!-- ear -->
        <ellipse cx="-22" cy="-18" rx="9" ry="13" fill="#8a603c" stroke="#6f4a2b" stroke-width="2" transform="rotate(-25 -22 -18)"/>
        <!-- long tapered snout pointing up-right -->
        <path d="M14,4 Q70,10 118,-26 Q126,-32 120,-40 Q70,-10 12,-8 Z"
              fill="#c39a70" stroke="#6f4a2b" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
        <path d="M112,-31 Q120,-36 118,-39 Q114,-40 108,-35" fill="#3a2a1c"/>
        <!-- tongue juggling-flavored flick -->
        <path d="M118,-36 Q150,-44 160,-62 Q150,-40 122,-31 Z" fill="#ef8fa0" stroke="#c65f75" stroke-width="1.5">
          <animate attributeName="d"
            values="M118,-36 Q150,-44 160,-62 Q150,-40 122,-31 Z;
                    M118,-36 Q145,-55 150,-78 Q143,-50 122,-31 Z;
                    M118,-36 Q150,-44 160,-62 Q150,-40 122,-31 Z"
            dur="1.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        </path>
      </g>

      <!-- Arms juggling (animate up/down alternately) -->
      <g>
        <path d="M-38,-60 Q-72,-40 -80,-8" fill="none" stroke="#8a603c" stroke-width="12" stroke-linecap="round">
          <animate attributeName="d"
            values="M-38,-60 Q-72,-40 -80,-8; M-38,-60 Q-78,-58 -84,-38; M-38,-60 Q-72,-40 -80,-8"
            dur="0.8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        </path>
        <circle cx="-82" cy="-8" r="8" fill="#6f4a2b">
          <animate attributeName="cy" values="-8;-38;-8" dur="0.8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        </circle>
      </g>
      <g>
        <path d="M38,-60 Q72,-40 80,-8" fill="none" stroke="#8a603c" stroke-width="12" stroke-linecap="round">
          <animate attributeName="d"
            values="M38,-60 Q78,-58 84,-38; M38,-60 Q72,-40 80,-8; M38,-60 Q78,-58 84,-38"
            dur="0.8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        </path>
        <circle cx="82" cy="-38" r="8" fill="#6f4a2b">
          <animate attributeName="cy" values="-38;-8;-38" dur="0.8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        </circle>
      </g>

      <!-- Tail feather-like sweep -->
      <path d="M-40,0 Q-95,30 -110,90 Q-88,60 -30,40 Z" fill="#8a603c" stroke="#6f4a2b" stroke-width="2">
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="0 -40 0; 12 -40 0; 0 -40 0" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </path>
    </g>

    <!-- ===== Juggling bottles ===== -->
    <!-- Each bottle follows a closed cascade path around the hands (400±82, y=335-8≈327) -->
    <g transform="translate(400,327)">
      <g>
        <animateMotion dur="2.4s" repeatCount="indefinite" rotate="auto">
          <mpath href="#juggle1"/>
        </animateMotion>
        <use href="#bottle"/>
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="0;360;720" dur="2.4s" repeatCount="indefinite" additive="sum"/>
      </g>
      <g>
        <animateMotion dur="2.4s" begin="-0.8s" repeatCount="indefinite" rotate="auto">
          <mpath href="#juggle2"/>
        </animateMotion>
        <use href="#bottle"/>
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="0;360;720" dur="2.4s" begin="-0.8s" repeatCount="indefinite" additive="sum"/>
      </g>
      <g>
        <animateMotion dur="2.4s" begin="-1.6s" repeatCount="indefinite" rotate="auto">
          <mpath href="#juggle3"/>
        </animateMotion>
        <use href="#bottle"/>
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="0;360;720" dur="2.4s" begin="-1.6s" repeatCount="indefinite" additive="sum"/>
      </g>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Caption -->
  <text x="400" y="585" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Trebuchet MS, Verdana, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f6b3a">
    The Juggling Anteater
    <animate attributeName="fill" values="#2f6b3a;#c2410c;#2f6b3a" dur="5s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </text>
</svg>

content.text:
Created **`anteater-unicycle.svg`** — a 800×600 animated scene featuring:

- Wheel rotating unicycle with spinning pedals and moving legs
- 🐜 Anteater with a tapered snout, flicking tongue, shaggy fur tufts, and alternating juggling arms + swaying tail
- 🍼 Three green bottles cascading along looping juggling paths with staggered timing and spins
- ☁️ Drifting clouds, pulsing sun, gentle whole-body bobbing, and a color-cycling caption

All animation uses native SVG (`<animate>`, `<animateTransform>`, `<animateMotion>`), so it loops continuously when opened in any browser. Open it directly in a browser to view the animation.
